ActivationRouteSelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, `selected[]` the buyer's choice, which replaces it, and `deltas` the price of each option outside `included[]`, each by option id.

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

unit.description: What `quantity` counts. Core terms: the `frequency_cap.per` terms (§ 5.5), and `person`. A receiver that doesn't know a term reads the figure as unstated

data_label.description: The option's IAB Tech Lab Data Transparency Standard 1.1 label: every field in its "Minimum Segment Disclosures: Required Fields" table, keyed by its API flat file key, with values exactly as the standard publishes them, such as `Observed/Known` or `TCF (Europe)`. A multi-select field the standard gives no separator for is an array of those values. The standard's conditional rules apply: offline data sources require the Onboarder Details fields, which otherwise take the standard's `N/A` option; `Modeled` requires `audience_expansion: Yes`; and `Single domain / App` scope requires a domain or app store URL in `originating_domain`

excludable.description: Whether the buyer may name this option in `excluded[]`. Absent means `false`

sensitive_categories.description: The categories the option's membership is derived from or reveals. Core terms: `racial_or_ethnic_origin` | `political_opinions` | `religious_or_philosophical_beliefs` | `trade_union_membership` | `genetic` | `biometric` | `health` | `sex_life_or_sexual_orientation` | `precise_geolocation` | `minors` (under 18). An empty array declares none

taxonomy.description: The integer from the OpenRTB segment taxonomies list for the IDs that name this option: `4` (IAB Tech Lab Audience Taxonomy 1.1) for the label's `taxonomy_id_list`, or the seller's registered vendor value (500 and up) for the label's `audience_id`. When the seller signals the segment in an OpenRTB 2.6 request, these are the `data.ext.segtax` and `segment.id` values

combine.description: The operators the seller supports. `max_select: 1`. `included[]` MUST name exactly one option. It carries no `deltas`

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

excluded.description: The buyer's write: option ids of options whose `excludable` is `true`, disjoint from the seller audiences in effect. `max_select` does not count them

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

list_id.description: Identity of the list within the line item. The buyer uses it wherever the list's members travel

match_method.description: How its members match users. Core terms: `hashed_email` | `device_id`. A receiver that doesn't know a term reads the method as unstated

source.description: Where the list comes from, such as `advertiser_crm`

expected_match_rate.description: The seller's stated expectation of the share of a buyer's list that matches

suppression_list.description: The users the line item doesn't target
